name: RC-B10-0545/2025 – After § 1 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text: 1a. Underlines that the original 28-point plan produced by the United States constitutes a useful working basis for peace negotiations between Russia and Ukraine; welcomes US Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s statement that points related to the EU and NATO will be discussed separately with the organisations’ respective Member States; considers that, in line with the US plan, a fully fledged peace deal on Ukraine could also be a unique opportunity to solve long-lasting issues between the EU and Russia;
